content: The Spriters Resource terms permit site content where legally permitted or in unpublished non-commercial works and prohibit use in commercial works, including ad-supported or in-app-purchase games. Site permission does not erase rights in the original game's art. The project records user-stated permission, but should preserve written scope/provenance and have a replacement plan before publication. Integration should also normalize sheet frames, transparent padding, pivots, nearest-neighbor scaling, and atlas gutters to prevent jitter and bleeding.
